capabilities: Scaffold wiki folders, starter pages, and ontology templates in the vault
Run dry-run previews, health checks, and repair of missing template files
Back up overwritten files to timestamped backup folders
Optionally install a GitHub Actions wiki quality-gate workflow
Export setup reports with created, overwritten, and skipped file counts
disambiguation: Not a wiki engine or publisher; it only writes folders, template files, and scripts into the vault.
extras: Setup dialogs support English or Korean; bundled Python and PowerShell automation scripts are desktop-only and mobile is limited to structure and Markdown creation; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Building a wiki-style vault with ontology templates, folder conventions, and automation scripts by hand is slow and error-prone.
summary: Template kit installer that scaffolds an LLM wiki vault structure with starter pages, ontology templates, automation scripts, and an optional GitHub Actions workflow.
